_meta.description: Named crew, owned by Member 2. Names and modifier values are editable gameplay content. Feed the combined modifiers into the simulation's aggregate crew health/stress/productivity state; do not create a separate per-person health system.

crew.name: Leila Navarro
crew.notes: Operations lead. Apply as a modest aggregate morale-recovery bonus after a resolved event; her responsibility keeps the team's baseline stress slightly above the crew average.

crew.name: Devon Okoye
crew.notes: Power and maintenance specialist. Apply a targeted aggregate productivity bonus to repair and construction actions; do not reduce passive resource consumption.

crew.name: Dr. Jia Chen
crew.notes: Crop and life-support specialist. Apply a targeted aggregate productivity bonus to greenhouse actions and lower food-output variance once that system is implemented.

crew.name: Dr. Amara Sethi
crew.notes: Crew-care specialist. Apply a modest aggregate stress-mitigation bonus during health or radiation events; this is not a second health pool.
